rivals.name: HELIOS Research Authority
rivals.recovery_memo: HELIOS does not acquire liabilities. It acquires assets that have stopped arguing. You will be quiet, you will be productive, and you will be grateful - in that order.
rivals.recovery_orders: HELIOS demands weekly progress. Work fast and do not attract a second review.
taunts: Rennick (HELIOS): 'Cute prototype. We bought three companies before breakfast.'
Rennick (HELIOS): 'Your lead amuses our board. Briefly.'
Rennick (HELIOS): 'Our interns replicate your results before lunch. Then they improve them.'
Rennick (HELIOS): 'Forty percent. The board has stopped learning your name and started learning your assets.'

rivals.name: Bermant Laboratories
rivals.recovery_memo: Bermant keeps what it buys. Your division is now a line item with a pulse. Perform steadily and nobody needs to have a second conversation.
rivals.recovery_orders: Bermant audits on schedule. Steady output keeps them incurious.
taunts: Bermant: 'Slow and funded beats fast and broke, friend.'
Bermant: 'We publish. You posture. The field notices.'
Bermant: 'We budgeted for your mistakes too, friend. Ours is a generous spreadsheet.'
Bermant: 'Compounding is quiet until it is deafening. Listen.'

rivals.name: Northwind Institute
rivals.recovery_memo: Northwind believes sunlight disinfects. Your work will be published, your methods reviewed, your failures cited. Independence is earned in public.
rivals.recovery_orders: Northwind publishes everything - including, eventually, your reinstatement case.
taunts: Okafor (Northwind): 'Our preprint is already cited. Where is yours?'
Okafor (Northwind): 'Open science always wins. Ask anyone. We did.'
Okafor (Northwind): 'Your data would make a lovely appendix. In our paper.'
Okafor (Northwind): 'We cited you eleven times today. You are welcome. Enclosed: our market share.'

rivals.name: Vantage Dynamics
rivals.recovery_memo: Vantage bought you on a hunch and will sell you on one. Nineteen days? Twenty. Whatever. Impress us before the mood changes.
rivals.recovery_orders: Vantage attention is short. Big swings, fast.
taunts: Marsh (Vantage): 'Bet it all! Bet it all! (It worked. It always works.)'
Marsh (Vantage): 'Volatility is just victory, annualized.'
Marsh (Vantage): 'We shorted caution and went long on destiny!'
Marsh (Vantage): 'Forty percent on vibes and leverage! Read about it! (You will. We will make sure.)'

rivals.name: Solenne Foundation
rivals.recovery_memo: The Foundation preserves what matters. Prove you matter. Endure the review with grace and the endowment follows.
rivals.recovery_orders: Solenne reviews with patience and remembers everything.
taunts: Solenne: 'We endowed three chairs this quarter. What did you endow?'
Solenne: 'Patience compounds. So does our share price.'
Solenne: 'We have funded research since before your director was born. We can wait.'
Solenne: 'The endowment is patient. The endowment is also forty percent.'

rivals.name: Kitezh Group
rivals.recovery_memo: Kitezh does not own you. Kitezh is simply watching very closely from inside the building. Do good work. We will know.
rivals.recovery_orders: Kitezh watches from inside. Cover is life.
taunts: Moroz (Kitezh): 'The state provides. The state collects.'
Moroz (Kitezh): 'Your market is a rounding error in our five-year plan.'
Moroz (Kitezh): 'Our scientists work for the state. Yours work for stock options. Observe the difference.'
Moroz (Kitezh): 'The five-year plan is ahead of schedule. Your share is scheduled for reassignment.'
